body.objective: Fix the three BT endpoint-extension constants by imposing the exact oscillator CCR and transported-projector idempotence with perturbative Pi=1, then derive the continuum Gram and test 1/48 without fitting.
body.current_gate: CANONICAL_ENDPOINT: extend the order-lambda kernel on endpoint jets through degree two and solve c0,c1,c2 from CCR preservation, anti-Krein sharp, projector idempotence, exchange symmetry, and common incoming/outgoing regulation.
body.stop_condition: Derive and verify unique c0,c1,c2 and the 1/48 Gram, or certify the first exact residual canonical ambiguity/mismatch after every listed identity is imposed.
body.forbid: no fitted 1/48; no range defect on the formal branch; no arbitrary plus/cutoff choice; no omission of incoming sectors; no scalar-to-gravity or LORENTZIAN-CAUSAL promotion; exact arithmetic only
body.resource_hint: Represent each endpoint extension by its action on 1,z(1-z),z^2(1-z)^2. Build the order-lambda canonical transformation and impose commutators before Gram contraction. Use decisive mutations of delta signs and one endpoint. Run sequentially under ulimit -v 500000.
